characters.name: Su
characters.age: older adult (an older woman about the same age as Mu)
characters.voice_notes: Lead Minpentai priest and organizer of the nationals; gracious, composed host; gentle but firm when delivering bad news in chapter 15.

characters.name: Zei
characters.age: teen (final year of high school, about 17-18)
characters.voice_notes: Bright, intense, earnest; maths-minded Minpentai prodigy now studying cryptography; protagonist of the Dzego chapters. Proud but self-aware, eager to please his mentors.

characters.name: car driver
characters.voice_notes: Driver of the black car taking Zei to the venue; one flat, matter-of-fact line.

characters.name: Deluin
characters.voice_notes: Foreign contestant at the Minpentai nationals; friendly, confident, witty, a little lecturing; becomes Zei's friend. In chapter 15 he is only heard through written messages from occupied Redshire.

characters.name: Jin
characters.voice_notes: Taskmaster Jin, priest and lead organizer of the national championship; formal, ceremonial public-address delivery.

characters.name: Minpentai contestants
characters.voice_notes: The assembled contestants answering the Dzegoban motto in unison. The line sits inside a narrator run.

characters.name: Bai
characters.voice_notes: Sharp, competitive, teasing; orphan who had to fend for herself, guarded but warming up. Zei's Minpentai rival turned sparring partner.

characters.name: Bo
characters.voice_notes: Bo Zume, Zei's first opponent at the nationals; one polite greeting. Gender not stated.

characters.name: loud automated voice (Sadzu Du)
characters.voice_notes: Stadium countdown voice at the national championship that booms Dzegoban numerals in capitals; described as sounding more female than the Pafogai Du countdown voice of chapters 4 and 7, so cast it as a separate, female-sounding machine voice (or merge if one countdown voice is preferred).

characters.name: tournament announcer (Sadzu Du nationals)
characters.voice_notes: Stadium announcer at the national championship in Sadzu Du; grand, showman-like, addresses audience and players. A different venue from the Pafogai Du tournament announcer of chapters 4 and 7 (merge if one announcer voice is preferred).

notes: S is Su (Seila does not speak). D is Deluin except the car driver at 12:66; Den does not speak. B is Bai (on a call, 12:106-12:128) except Bo's greeting at 12:135. J is Taskmaster Jin, not Jahn. 12:98 is a narrator run with the contestants' unison reply in quotation marks plus a narration tag; split at the quotation marks. 12:102 is a call-request notification from Bai printed as narrator text; left as narration. Gender of Jin and Bo is not stated.
